findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_paid_apis, web_audit · Private data: generate_landing_page · Public sink: generate_landing_page, ar_dolar, ar_inflacion, ar_feriados, ar_cuit, ar_cbu, ar_phone, fx_rate, web_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_paid_apis, web_audit · Private data: generate_landing_page · Public sink: generate_landing_page, ar_dolar, ar_inflacion, ar_feriados, ar_cuit, ar_cbu, ar_phone, fx_rate, web_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_paid_apis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List this server's pay-per-call HTTP APIs that agents can buy with USDC via x402 (Base, Polygon or Solana), with URL, price, input schema and an example: Argentina dolar quotes (oficial, blue, MEP, CCL, cripto, tarjeta) and FX exchange rate (0.002), Argentine CUIT/CUIL and CBU/CVU validators and Arg" → after: "List this server's pay-per-call HTTP APIs that agents can buy with USDC via x402 (Base, Polygon or Solana), with URL, price, input schema and an example: Argentina dolar quotes (oficial, blue, MEP, CCL, cripto, tarjeta) and FX exchange rate (0.002), Argentine CUIT/CUIL and CBU/CVU validators and Arg"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
